title: Communications Officer
company: Wildfowl and Wetlands Trust - Agency - Permanent
description:
Communications Officer (Maternity Cover)
Salary: £32,630 per annum
Contract: 12 Month Fixed-Term
Work Pattern: Full Time, 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Location: WWT Slimbridge GL2. We support hybrid working, with an expectation for team members to be in Slimbridge at least once a week.

About The Role

Are you passionate about connecting people with nature?

Do you have the skills and creativity to help us promote WWT's ten incredible wetland centres and build our brand profile with new and diverse audiences?

Our ten wetland centres are the windows into our wetlands world. They offer engaging wetland nature experiences, build people's understanding of wetlands and their incredible superpowers, and promise up-close wetland wildlife encounters. And we're looking for an experienced Communications Officer to deliver creative multi-channel communications that promote our wetland centres and encourage more people to come and experience them for themselves.

Working closely with our Visitor Marketing team, this role will work across communications disciplines, flexing to support our marketing priorities through media relations and PR, social media, events management and internal communications. This is a really exciting opportunity to make a real difference for nature, to speak up for wetlands and wildlife and inspire new and existing audiences to visit and act for these amazing habitats.

We're an organisation of action, running multiple conservation projects and networks in the UK and around the world, as well as our own ten wetland visitor sites in the UK. This hands-on role demands flexibility, imagination and a willingness to lead on delivering impactful and dynamic communications. You'll help us bring wetlands and WWT to more people, through engaging storytelling and creative content, inspire our staff and volunteers and build our profile across on and offline channels.

About You

We are seeking someone:
- Experienced in delivering successful communications plans aimed at a diverse range of public audiences.
- With a track record of delivering creative communications activity across a range of internal and external channels, including social media, PR, events, and digital content.
- An intuitive thinker and engaging writer, you'll be able to seek out and tell stories aimed at raising an organisation's profile and driving action.
- With a creative eye, you'll be comfortable capturing content and turning it into accessible, on-brand communications for social media channels like Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn, and for media and PR storytelling.
- Comfortable building relationships externally and internally, with a range of levels and stakeholders from journalists and partners to senior leaders and volunteers.
- Experienced in planning and delivering events that support the achievement of organisation objectives.
- Organised and able to manage competing priorities while remaining calm in a busy working environment.

About Us

We're WWT, and we're on a mission to restore the super-powered ecosystems we call wetlands. There's never been a more important moment for our work, and we've got some phenomenal people on the case.

Whether they're taking a new visitor under their wing, or conducting ground-breaking research further afield, our team are second to none. And there's nothing we love more than watching them soar.

Whatever you do here, you'll be helping to restore wetlands and unlock their power. So, the only question left is, what role will you play?

Why you'll love working at WWT
- Wake up every day knowing your work is helping to restore wetlands, and our world
- Be surrounded and inspired by our team of passionate, dedicated people
- 33 days annual leave (which goes up to 38 days after 5 years of service) - this includes bank holidays and you have flexibility to take those days whenever you want
- Free entry to all our wetland centres, including your family
- Free car parking and secure bike storage areas
- Colleague discount on shopping and memberships
- Cycle to work scheme
- Contributory pension scheme
- Life Assurance of three times your salary, for peace of mind for your loved ones
- Independent personal, workplace and financial advice from Care first

Additional Information

The role is a full time 12 month fixed term contract, working 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday based at WWT Slimbridge Wetland Centre, Gloucestershire. We support hybrid working, with an expectation for team members to be in Slimbridge at least once a week.

If you want to make a direct contribution to the conservation of wetlands and wetland wildlife at a critical moment for the natural world, then please submit an application.

Closing Date: Sunday 18th October 2026
N.B. We reserve the right to close the advert early if we receive a sufficient number of applications from candidates who meet the required skills and experience. We therefore encourage early applications.

Interested?

If you would like to find out more, please click the apply button. You will be directed to our website to complete your application for this position.

WWT is an equal opportunities employer and all applications will be considered solely on merit.

No agencies please.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager

£37,000 - £37500 DOE

Hybrid Working (3:2)

Gloucester

3-Year Fixed-Term Contract

Are you a strategic and creative marketer looking for an opportunity to make a lasting impact?

Juice Recruitment is delighted to be supporting a leading organisation within the education and skills sector in the search for an experienced Marketing Manager. This is a unique opportunity to lead the marketing strategy for a high-profile Digital and Technology excellence programme that is helping to shape the future workforce across the region.

This role would suit a commercially aware marketing professional who enjoys developing innovative campaigns, building strategic partnerships and creating engaging content that delivers measurable results.

The Role

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, you will be responsible for developing and delivering a comprehensive marketing strategy that supports learner recruitment, employer engagement and stakeholder communications across a flagship digital and technology initiative.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Developing and implementing integrated marketing campaigns to drive awareness, applications and enrolments.
- Managing digital marketing activity including websites, landing pages, SEO, paid advertising, social media and email campaigns.
- Creating compelling content, case studies and success stories that demonstrate programme impact and learner outcomes.
- Supporting employer engagement through targeted campaigns, events, communications and partnership activity.
- Developing PR and communications plans to increase visibility, strengthen brand positioning and showcase achievements.
- Working collaboratively with internal stakeholders and external partners to maximise engagement opportunities.
- Monitoring campaign performance and producing meaningful insights to support future decision-making and growth.

About You

We are keen to speak with candidates who can demonstrate:
- Proven experience in marketing strategy, campaign planning and delivery.
- Strong digital marketing expertise across multiple channels.
- Excellent content creation and storytelling skills.
- Experience managing stakeholder relationships and collaborative partnerships.
- Event planning and project management experience.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
- A proactive, organised and creative approach to work.

Experience within education, training, skills development or membership organisations would be advantageous, but is not essential.
- The Package:
- Salary of £37,266
- Hybrid working model
- Generous annual leave allowance
- Employer pension contribution scheme
- Opportunity to work on a nationally recognised programme
- A collaborative and supportive working environment with genuine opportunities to make an impact

Interested?

If you're looking for a role where you can combine strategic marketing expertise with meaningful work that supports future talent, innovation and regional growth, we'd love to hear from you.

title: PR Account Manager - inhouse or agency welcome!
company: Moxie and Mettle Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
PR Account Manager

We are looking for a PR Account Manager to join an established communications agency, working across a varied portfolio of clients and sectors.

Our lovely client is happy to look at somebody who works clientside in PR/comms as well as an agency, though you will need to have worked on multiple campaigns at one time and also have been involved with budget planning, as this is a crucial part of the PR account management role.

About You

Some previous PR/communications experience is essential, from agency OR clientside.
- Involvement with budget allocation and planning
- Ability to handle multiple campaigns at one time
- Obviously excellent written communication skills
- The ability to turn complex information into clear, engaging stories
- Ambition and drive to progress your PR career!

The Opportunity

You're rejoining an incredibly collaborative and supportive team whether there is an outstanding culture with clear path for progression and development within the next 12 to 18 months.

You'll be office based three times a week, but the other two days can be remote, and you will also benefit from flexible start times, so for example, your working pattern could 8am-4pm or 10am-6pm or anything in between those hours - which makes your work/life balance a lot easier!

The Role

As an Account Manager, you will take responsibility for managing client accounts and delivering effective communications activity that supports their wider business objectives.

You will work closely with clients to understand their priorities, develop creative ideas and identify opportunities to raise their profile with relevant audiences.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing day-to-day relationships with a portfolio of clients.
- Developing and delivering integrated PR and communications campaigns.
- Providing strategic communications advice and recommendations.
- Identifying compelling stories, angles and opportunities for clients.
- Building relationships with journalists and securing relevant media coverage.
- Writing and editing press releases, features, articles, case studies and other content.
- Supporting digital and social media activity where appropriate.
- Managing multiple projects, deadlines and budgets.
- Briefing and supporting junior members of the team.
- Monitoring campaign results and reporting back to clients.
- Keeping up to date with news, media trends and developments relevant to clients.
